info.title: PRO3 Full System — Part 4
info.description: Independent station APIs. Commands commit locally, then synchronize asynchronously. Central GET requests require RECALL_TOKEN; station APIs require STATION_TOKEN only when configured. Central rejects writes. Product recalls use the separate protobuf contract. Unknown/duplicate fields are rejected; JSON body limit 128 KiB. See system-api.md for detailed rules.
